name: Gradient-Weighted Feature Back-Projection
definition: A training-free method for feature field rendering in 3D Gaussian Splatting that back-projects 2D features into pre-trained 3D Gaussians using a weighted sum based on each Gaussian's influence (opacity and transmittance) in the final rendering.
summary: Gradient-Weighted Feature Back-Projection is a training-free method that aggregates 2D features into 3D Gaussians using opacity and transmittance weights, offering 10x speed over training-based alternatives.
